scope: Read-only design review plus CPU native geometry/constitution attribute mutation on an isolated in-memory mesh; no runtime source edits, no GPU Engine/World/init, no simulated improvement claim.

mapping.implementation_requirement: Use position bijection plus canonical sorted mapped vertex triplets; reshape native topology to (-1,3); do not assume these index ranges or identity mapping for a future asset.

native_coefficients.shear_semantics: Independent effective 2D coefficient, backend multiplies triangle rest area; do not multiply by thickness again.

basis_caution: Match native Dm2x2 Rodrigues rotation from each rest normal to +Z, followed by XY extraction, not a first-triangle-edge basis or source UV weave. Current native material directions are not validated manufactured webbing yarn directions.

recommendation.first_candidate: Change only both handles mu 50 -> 250 N/m using named source handle groups; preserve all other properties and every physical gate. This is an uncalibrated effective stronger-strap material trial, not measured webbing.
recommendation.reason: Failing edge elongation is dominated by material-axis shear; increasing stretch lambda alone may do little because I5u/I5v stay near one. Uniform body mu would alter the requested floppy bag drape unnecessarily.
recommendation.runtime_insertion_point: Existing configure_shell_shear hook after native FEM creation, before World.init; backend caches per-face coefficients at init.
do_not_do: No runtime material edit after build
recommendation.bending: Leave 5e-5 N m unchanged initially; membrane shear and bending are independent. If a later calibrated strap bend change is needed, modify only native edges whose two incident triangles are both handle faces, leaving body/strap seam interfaces unchanged and documenting that boundary policy.

minimal_next_tests: CPU adapter tests: exact source/native bijections; both handles selected, body byte-identical; positive finite coefficients; reject mapping or topology mismatch.
One native short physical build/drape/grasp smoke: startup report confirms 704 handle coefficients and 2960 original body coefficients, no invalid initial contacts, no fixed vertices.

True full initialization trial with unchanged force/torque/J/table/stretch/grip/final containment gates; stiffness change can alter early grasp, load transfer and passage, so no success assumed from saved-state analysis.
